focus.title: 美国拟对东南亚光伏产品加征反倾销税，中国转口企业面临合规风险
focus.summary: 美国商务部初步裁定，部分从越南、泰国、马来西亚进口的光伏电池存在倾销行为，拟加征6%至271%不等的反倾销税。此举旨在堵截中国光伏企业经由东南亚转口至美国的避税路径。中国出海企业需立即审查供应链安排，评估关税影响及原产地规则合规性。
focus.title_en: US Proposes Anti-Dumping Duties on Solar Imports from Southeast Asia, China's Transshipment Firms Face Compliance Risks
focus.summary_en: The U.S. Department of Commerce preliminarily ruled that certain solar cells imported from Vietnam, Thailand, and Malaysia were dumped, proposing anti-dumping duties ranging from 6% to 271%. This move aims to block Chinese solar companies' tax avoidance via Southeast Asian transshipment. Chinese overseas enterprises should immediately review supply chains and assess tariff impacts and origin rule compliance.
focus.source_en: Source: U.S. Department of Commerce announcement · 2026.07.28

case.title: 新加坡ICC仲裁裁决获中国法院承认与执行：仲裁条款效力认定成关键
case.summary: 最高人民法院近期裁定承认并执行新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）的一项仲裁裁决。争议焦点在于仲裁条款的书面形式是否符合《纽约公约》要求。法院最终认定双方通过电子邮件确认的仲裁协议有效，驳回了被申请人以缺乏签字为由的抗辩。此案为中国企业参与国际仲裁提供了重要参考，强调电子通讯方式仲裁条款的效力。
case.source: 来源：最高人民法院典型案例 · 2026年7月
case.title_en: Singapore ICC Arbitral Award Recognized and Enforced by Chinese Court: Validity of Arbitration Clause Key
case.summary_en: The Supreme People's Court recently ruled to recognize and enforce an arbitral award from the Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC). The dispute centered on whether the written form of the arbitration clause complied with the New York Convention. The court held that the arbitration agreement confirmed via email was valid, rejecting the argument of lack of signature. This case provides important guidance for Chinese enterprises in international arbitration, affirming the validity of arbitration clauses in electronic communications.
case.source_en: Source: Supreme People's Court typical case · July 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规落地，企业需建立数据出境安全评估机制
policy.summary: 广东省互联网信息办公室发布《粤港澳大湾区（内地、香港、澳门）个人信息和重要数据出境安全评估办法》，要求向港澳提供重要数据的企业进行安全评估。新规明确了评估流程、时限及禁止出境的场景。企业应在三个月内完成自查，建立数据分类分级与出境安全评估制度。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026.07.28
policy.title_en: New Cross-Border Data Flow Rules in Greater Bay Area: Enterprises Must Establish Data Exit Security Assessment Mechanism
policy.summary_en: The Guangdong Provincial Cyberspace Administration issued the "Security Assessment Measures for the Cross-Border Transfer of Personal Information and Important Data in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (Mainland, Hong Kong, Macao)", requiring enterprises providing important data to Hong Kong and Macao to undergo security assessment. The rules specify assessment procedures, timelines, and prohibited scenarios. Enterprises should complete self-inspection within three months and establish data classification and cross-border security assessment systems.

analysis.title: 中企海外投资应重视反腐败合规体系建设：从FCPA执法趋势看实务要点
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国《反海外腐败法》（FCPA）2026年上半年执法力度显著加强，针对中国企业及第三国中间人的调查增多。建议出海企业在投资前对合资方、代理商进行反腐败尽职调查，建立内部举报机制与合规培训体系。尤其应关注礼品、招待、第三方付款等高风险环节，避免因中间人行为引发连带责任。
analysis.title_en: Chinese Overseas Investors Should Prioritize Anti-Corruption Compliance: Practical Insights from FCPA Enforcement Trends
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA) enforcement has significantly intensified in the first half of 2026, with increased investigations targeting Chinese enterprises and third-country intermediaries. It is recommended that overseas enterprises conduct anti-corruption due diligence on joint venture partners and agents, establish internal reporting mechanisms, and compliance training programs. Particular attention should be paid to high-risk areas such as gifts, hospitality, and third-party payments to avoid vicarious liability from intermediary misconduct.
